agreement.title: Before you start
agreement.intro: Please read how this tool works and how we handle your family's information.
agreement.termsBody: Using this tool means you agree to the AAP terms of use and privacy policy.
agreement.dataBody: Your children's details, vaccine records and any photos of records you scan are saved to your HealthyChildren.org account so you can see them on any device. Scanned photos are kept only until you finish reviewing them, unless you choose to keep them, and you can delete them at any time.
agreement.remindersBody: We only send text or email reminders if you turn them on in Settings.
agreement.adviceBody: This tool helps you keep track and prepare questions. It does not replace your pediatrician's advice.
agreement.termsLink: Read the full terms of use
agreement.checkbox: I have read and agree to the terms of use and privacy policy.
agreement.updated: We've updated our terms. Please review and agree to continue.
